description: This source file defines the GatewayConnectivityCoordinator class, responsible for managing the runtime connectivity to a gateway endpoint, subscribing to endpoint state updates, and handling URL resolution and labeling within a macOS application.

classes.name: GatewayConnectivityCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the connection state to a gateway endpoint, listening for updates and maintaining relevant endpoint information.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the endpoint subscription task to listen for state updates.

methods.name: handleEndpointState
methods.description: Handles updates to the endpoint state, updating internal properties accordingly and triggering refresh actions when necessary.

methods.name: hostLabel
methods.description: Generates a human-readable label for a given URL's host and port.
